slug: 2025-10-31 Cabo Verde launches national SOC and CSIRT

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Cabo Verde launched a CSIRT within the State's Private Technological Network (RTPE), described as a national cyber alert-and-response hub for public institutions and private organisations; no event date is given, so the publication date 2025-10-31 is used.

note: No incident handled, alert, critical infrastructure designation or figures stated.

facts.fact: Expresso das Ilhas reports the minister announced the public launch of the CSIRT of the State's Private Technological Network, built by NOSi, to strengthen the State's capacity to respond to cyber incidents; no event date is given, so the publication date 2025-10-30 is used.

note: No incident handled, alert, critical infrastructure designation or figures stated.

facts.fact: The NOSi 2024 plan notes Decreto-lei 9/2021 and Decreto-Regulamentar 1/2021 creating the national CSIRT, and commits NOSi to implement the CSIRT RTPE in 2024; no incident or alert is stated.

note: No incident handled, alert, critical infrastructure designation or figures stated.

facts.fact: NOSi states the public launch started the activities of the CSIRT of the State's Private Technological Network, with World Bank financing and Visionware as partner, to help public administration and the private sector; the document is dated 2025-10-30 and gives no other event date.

note: No incident handled, alert, critical infrastructure designation or figures stated.

facts.fact: The Government states the SOC and CSIRT of the State's Private Technological Network, developed by NOSi, were publicly launched in Praia on Wednesday 29 October 2025, to monitor, prevent and respond to cyber incidents.

note: No incident handled, alert, critical infrastructure designation or figures stated.
Cabo Verde only hosted the November 2024 ECOWAS CSIRT meeting; no national body stated.

The record states the national SOC and CSIRT were launched on 30 October 2025.
